descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-02 ER; TFA-92580 AC 2 · “The scanned list adds patients automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing.”.

Bug B01 · S0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read. Re-check 2026-10-17 on dev 25acd727 (TFA-92580, TC-02): 14 of 14 photo reads empty while the model answered (gemini-3.6-flash, ok, 2.3–9.9 s); in-process on 25acd727 code a ```json-fenced reply gives 0 rows and bare JSON 3.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-02/S02, TC-02/S06, TC-02/S07, TC-02/S08, TC-02/S14, TC-02/S16

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S01 Hospital: a clean census screenshot adds every patient with no re-typing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician on the local stack, on the Hospital list (fixture patient only)

When Scan patient list from photo → Take Photo or Choose Image → upload h-day1-clean.png → confirm all rows

Then The 3 rows show with the name, room, diagnosis and MRN from the image. After confirming, all 3 are on the Hospital list next to the fixture patient, and each scanned patient's chart opens at Follow-up

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints below. 'No re-typing' (U1) is decided by a post-run read of the MCP session log: any browser_type call between the upload and the s01-list checkpoint fails the case. Follow-up is judged on the chart's selected admission status (U6). A preflight failure makes this Blocked, not Fail

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (real image through setInputFiles, real scan path)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
